title: List
description: A curated list of Radio-Browser stations. See README.md.

title.description: In one language, picked by the curator for the list's listeners. Says what is in the list rather than a mood.

description.description: One sentence, in the same language as `title`.

curators.description: GitHub logins of the people who keep the list up; the first answers the issues CI opens.

checked.description: Date of the last full review by hand (a TOML date). Never shown in the app; a review issue is opened a year later.

use.description: What the list is listened to for: ids from vocab.toml.

genres.description: The genres that dominate the list, if any: ids from vocab.toml.

stations.description: Radio-Browser station UUIDs, in the curator's order. One UUID per station, followed by a comment with its name.
